constants: Captured full actor instructions, chronological stimuli, time, response schema, model, effort, token limit and all non-persona messages.
catalog_only: Only identified alternative-value catalogs/notes are removed. Selected individual descriptions and every other original persona field remain.
new_biographies: Same sampled characteristics, new elaborations from the scoped-generator candidate.
acceptance: Diagnostic only; no empirical calibration or population inference from six replays.

quality_audit.finding: Only three infants were regenerated. No adult rating was selected by a correction loop in the complete CF5 run, so disabling correction is not a supported adult-rating remedy.
